routes.title: Krabi Airport to Koh Lanta Private Taxi | VIP Taxi Lanta
routes.metaDescription: Private taxi or minivan between Krabi Airport (KBV) and Koh Lanta, both directions, door to door. Cash to the driver, no prepayment. Price on WhatsApp.
routes.h1: Krabi Airport to Koh Lanta, private taxi and minivan
routes.lead: Door to door between Krabi Airport (KBV) and your hotel on Koh Lanta, in either direction. Your group only, no sharing.
body: Give us your flight number and landing time, your hotel on Koh Lanta and the number of people. The team confirms the price on WhatsApp and the driver waits for you at the airport.
For the way back, enter your hotel as the pickup and Krabi Airport as the destination, with the time you want to leave.

faq.q: Where does the driver meet me at Krabi Airport?
faq.a: At the time you give us, at the airport. Send your flight number and the team confirms the meeting point on WhatsApp.

faq.q: Can I book the transfer back to Krabi Airport?
faq.a: Yes. Enter your hotel as the pickup and Krabi Airport as the destination, with your date and pickup time.

routes.title: Phuket Airport to Koh Lanta Private Taxi | VIP Taxi Lanta
routes.metaDescription: Private minivan or taxi between Phuket Airport (HKT) and Koh Lanta, both directions, hotel to hotel, one vehicle. Cash to the driver. Price on WhatsApp.
routes.h1: Phuket Airport to Koh Lanta, private transfer
routes.lead: A private minivan or taxi between Phuket Airport (HKT) and your hotel on Koh Lanta, in either direction, with no change of vehicle.
body: You travel in one vehicle from Phuket Airport to your hotel door on Koh Lanta, with stops when you want them. Send your flight time, your hotel and the number of people, and the team replies with the price.
The same transfer runs from Koh Lanta to Phuket Airport for your departure.

faq.q: Is it one vehicle all the way from Phuket Airport?
faq.a: Yes. Private taxi or minivan from the airport to your hotel on Koh Lanta, no change of vehicle.

faq.q: Can we stop on the way?
faq.a: Tell the driver. It is your vehicle for the trip.

faq.q: Can you pick up at Surat Thani bus terminal?

how.title: Private only
how.text: Taxi or minivan for your group only. No sharing, no waiting for other passengers.

how.title: Confirmed on WhatsApp

how.title: Cash to the driver

how.title: Children and babies
how.text: Add them in the form and ask for a child seat or a baby seat.

faq.q: Is the transfer private?
faq.a: Yes. Every transfer is private, with no sharing, so you travel only with your group.

faq.q: How do I pay?

faq.q: Can I travel with children or babies?
faq.a: Yes. The request form lets you add children and babies and ask for a child seat or a baby seat.
